description: Outdoor free-time destinations by the Charles River and walking connectors from campus locations. Built by data-pipeline/build_outdoor_spots.py.
crossings: Storrow Drive (a motorway) is not walkable; the river is reached over the BU Beach footbridge (OSM way 114011284) and other grade-separated paths in the network.

spots.name: BU Beach
spots.note: Lawn between Marsh Plaza's buildings and Storrow Drive; students sit and study on the grass.

spots.name: Charles River Reservation lawn
spots.note: The large riverbank lawn between Storrow Drive and the water west of the BU Beach footbridge; sitting by the river.

spots.name: Riverbank lawn by the BU Bridge
spots.note: Grass by the river path just east of the BU Bridge.

spots.name: Dr. Paul Dudley White Path
spots.note: Walks and runs along the river path on the Boston bank: west from the BU Beach footbridge toward the BU Bridge and back, then east and back.
